description.text: Education is an interdisciplinary branch of the social sciences encompassing pedagogy, psychology, linguistics, history etc, which are all applied to the topic of elementary, secondary, post- secondary education, special education, physical education and vocational education. The education programs are related to Teacher Preparation, Curriculum and Instruction, Education Technology, Educational Psychology, Educational Administration and so on.

duration.text: The Ideological Education at Jinzhou Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 35, and is in good health, preferably with a Bachelor’s Degree or above. Certified academic records and 2 letters of recommendation by 2 associate professors are required. The HSK score should reach level 4 or above.
